kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نقترب (form VIII)
# نَقْتَرِبُ (naqtaribu) /naq.ta.ri.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَبَ (iqtaraba)
# نَقْتَرِبَ (naqtariba) /naq.ta.ri.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَرَبَ (iqtaraba)
# نَقْتَرِبْ (naqtarib) /naq.ta.rib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِقْتَرَبَ (iqtaraba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
